title: Bacon Cheeseburger Soup
ingredients: 1 Tbsp bacon grease or olive oil
Chopped celery and carrots (equal in amount to the onion)
1/4 cup sour cream (or 1/2 block cream cheese)
instructions: Step 1: Brown the ground beef in a large stock pot. Once cooked, use a paper towel to remove excess grease, then remove from the pot and set aside.
Step 2: Add the bacon grease (or olive oil) and 1 Tbsp butter to the pot over medium heat. Once melted, add the onion, carrots, and celery, season with basil, salt, and pepper, and stir until tender.
Step 3: Once the carrots are softened, add the remaining 3 Tbsp butter and the flour, stirring to coat evenly. Cook a few minutes to brown and remove the raw flour taste.
Step 4: Add the potatoes and stir until incorporated. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a light boil, stirring occasionally.
Step 5: Once the potatoes are fork tender, add the milk, sour cream, and Velveeta; stir until the cheese is completely melted into the soup.
Step 6: Turn off the heat and add the chopped bacon (save some to garnish if desired). Taste and adjust seasoning. Top with parsley or serve with crackers and croutons.
notes: Recipe by Justin Holmes (Holmes Cooking) from the pinned first comment on a Facebook reel. The reel does not show where the cooked ground beef is added back; it is presumably returned to the pot with the bacon or broth.
